title: Bomb
desc: This tale shows the people of the land and humanity's strong ability to stay together through any situation, teaching hope, courage, and shared strength.

title: Rasu Kutty
desc: Rasukutty, spoiled son, matures through family feuds, love, and deception. He fights for Rukmani, learns literacy, and unites his family after shocking truths.

title: Iru Medaigal
desc: Two criminals, Balaram and Ranga, team up after a mistaken kidnapping. They chase Devaki and Radha, uncover Rajalingam's schemes, and confront guardian Devaki over fortune.
